steps.title: Original capture
steps.description: Raw smart-phone photograph of the signing sheet.

steps.title: Normalised size (1600 px)
steps.description: Every sheet is processed at one fixed working resolution so all kernel sizes and thresholds stay comparable.

steps.title: Grayscale conversion
steps.description: BGR to a single luminance channel; the colour of the pen is ignored at this stage.

steps.title: Bilateral denoising
steps.description: Edge-preserving smoothing removes camera noise but keeps the thin pen strokes intact.

steps.title: Deskew (-2.27 deg)
steps.description: A Hough transform on the long table rules gives the tilt of the page; the image is rotated back to horizontal.

steps.title: Illumination flattening
steps.description: Morphological closing estimates the paper background; dividing by it removes shadows and hot-spots.

steps.title: Adaptive binarisation
steps.description: Gaussian adaptive threshold (block 41, C 12): ink becomes white, paper becomes black.

steps.title: Morphological opening
steps.description: A 2x2 opening deletes isolated speckles left by JPEG compression.

steps.title: Horizontal rule extraction
steps.description: Opening with a wide, one-pixel-tall kernel keeps only the horizontal rules of the table.

steps.title: Vertical rule extraction
steps.description: Opening with a tall, one-pixel-wide kernel keeps only the vertical rules.

steps.title: Reconstructed table skeleton
steps.description: A bitwise OR of both rule masks rebuilds the grid.

steps.title: Table localisation
steps.description: Student table found at (188,721) size 1120x311; 5 columns by 7 rows

steps.title: Signature cell segmentation
steps.description: The last column of every student row is isolated - these are the regions of interest.

steps.title: Per-cell ink extraction
steps.description: Left: the cropped signature cell. Right: the colour-independent ink mask (dark stroke OR high saturation) after small-component removal. Ink coverage is compared against the 1.5% threshold.

steps.title: Attendance verdict
steps.description: Green = signature detected (present), red = empty cell (absent).
